task.topic: Among patients hospitalized with severe influenza, do convalescent plasma or hyperimmune immunoglobulin products reduce all-cause mortality versus a control product or placebo?

pico.population: Adults or children hospitalized with severe influenza
pico.exposure: Convalescent plasma or hyperimmune intravenous immunoglobulin
pico.comparator: Control plasma, intravenous immunoglobulin, or placebo

integrity_checks: Do not use target-review forest counts or effects.
Do not mix randomised and post-randomisation analysis populations within a study.
Use a documented 0.5 correction only when a 2x2 table has a zero cell.

extraction_notes: Extract counts, denominators, cohort and timepoint only; effect calculation belongs to the calculator.

candidate_capture_policy.record_scope: Capture source-reported mortality events and denominators for an eligible immune-product versus control contrast; selection is deferred.

extraction.model_selection_policy: Preserve every source-reported candidate; no study or effect selection occurs in extraction.
extraction.exclusion_concepts: Extract counts, denominators, cohort and timepoint only; effect calculation belongs to the calculator.
extraction.evidence_requirements: Transcribe only source-supported data, preserve exact evidence, and do not calculate, pool, choose an analysis record, or infer missing values.
